transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I need to run through the round-robin review with lab quality, waste logistics, and warehouse supervision before I can approve the disposal route and shipment controls. Can we get that scheduled today so we can move this forward?

transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we proceed. My laboratory analysis found 2.4% chlorinated solvent in the spent coolant. Per our site's waste matrix, any batch at or above 1.0% chlorinated solvent has to go to hazardous-liquid treatment rather than ordinary coolant recycling. I completed the analysis yesterday, but the result hasn't been attached to the waste authorization yet. We need to account for this before Elena approves the disposal route.

We need to make sure the shipment controls Elena approves reflect this split-load requirement.
